title: Masked Figure with Text
coreRelationships: The white text on the black bandana creates a strong visual contrast and integrates the typography directly into the figure's form.
The figure's eyes are the focal point, drawing the viewer's attention and conveying intensity.
The stark black and white palette emphasizes the graphic nature of the illustration and creates a sense of drama.
The text on the cap is mirrored and partially obscured, adding a layer of visual complexity and intrigue.
reuseFormula: Recreate the high-contrast, monochromatic stencil-like illustration of a masked figure. The figure wears a black bandana and cap, with visible eyes. Overlay white, condensed, uppercase sans-serif text onto the bandana, conforming to its folds, and mirrored white, condensed, uppercase sans-serif text onto the cap. Maintain tight tracking and leading for all text.
